Retention is visible for both objects. Move the camera farther inside white and carry the plush above the right half of blue; keep both jaws fully closed.

The dark plush is retained. Lift and move it toward blue. Lower the right gripper around the centered watch band, close, and test with a short lift.
Both retained objects are visible between the jaws. Carry the dark plush to the left side of blue and lift the watch toward red, keeping the two arms in their own workspaces.
